title: Disallow Dockerfile symlinks escaping build context
body:
## Summary

This change aligns Buildah with Docker/BuildKit behavior by rejecting Dockerfile paths
inside the build context that resolve (via symlink) to a target outside the context.

## What Changed

- Validate Dockerfile paths in `imagebuildah.BuildDockerfiles` to ensure any symlink
  resolves within `ContextDirectory`.
- Add a regression test that reproduces the symlink-escape scenario.

## Why

Builds should not be able to read files outside the declared build context.
Docker/BuildKit fails in this case; Buildah previously allowed it. This fixes the
inconsistency and closes the security gap.

## Testing

```bash
go test ./imagebuildah \
  -run TestDockerfileSymlinkOutsideContext \
  -tags "containers_image_openpgp exclude_graphdriver_btrfs"
```

> **Note:** Full `go test ./...` fails in this container due to conformance tests
> requiring privileged operations (overlay mounts and chown).

## Closes

Closes #6861

comments.body: Some unhappy tests which I restarted.
You're going to want to rebase to pick up missing packages that are causing those "pivot_root: command not found" test failures, added to the VM images that we updated to in #6911.

There seems to be an overlap with https://github.com/podman-container-tools/buildah/pull/6886 which, as far as I can tell, deals with the same problem but at the level of `DiscoverContainerfile` instead of `BuildDockerfiles`.

When I tested this PR, this corner case https://github.com/podman-container-tools/buildah/pull/6886#issuecomment-4958005777 differs from Docker behavior the same way as the other PR used to.
@nalind Could you take another look when you get a chance? thanks

@mahendrarathore1742 could you align this with the resolution semantics in the PR i linked above? I don't think the way it is now ensures consistency with Docker. As I pointed out, Docker seems to resolve within root, while your fix just rejects.

```shell
# working directory somewhere in /home

# Docker resolves within root

$ ls -l Dockerfile 
lrwxrwxrwx. 1 sbrauner sbrauner 23 Aug 18 13:38 Dockerfile -> /tmp/test/Containerfile

## This fails even if `/tmp/test/Containerfile` exists, because it gets resolved as `/.../context/tmp/test/Containerfile` which does not.

$ docker build -t test -f Dockerfile .
ERROR: failed to build: failed to solve: failed to read dockerfile: open Dockerfile: no such file or directory

$ mkdir -p tmp/test
$ cat Dockerfile > tmp/test/Containerfile

## After the file is written, Docker finds the file successfully.

$ docker build -t test -f Dockerfile .

# Buildah after this PR rejects

## While in this PR, the absolute symlink is just rejected without looking at `/.../context/tmp/test/Containerfile`  at all.

$ buildah build -t test -f Dockerfile .
Error: containerfile "Dockerfile" resolves to "/tmp/test/Containerfile" outside of the build context "/home/..."
```
